description.narrative: Technical assistance will support the development and implementation of the UK's influencing strategy of humanitarian agencies, the UN architecture, other donors and Governments in line with UK’s national and development interests and policy, for example on joint needs assessments and humanitarian cash as well as influencing the coordination architecture to better link humanitarian and development coordination under the auspices of the ‘Triple Nexus’.
